guidanceForFetchers: Legacy /pages/*.html URLs are served as redirects for compatibility, but canonical URLs are excluded from the sitemap.
Read llms.txt first if you need a short human-readable overview.
Use the sections array for route discovery and intent.
Use sitemap.xml for static file URLs under /pages and /writings.
Hash routes are the live SPA navigation, while the .html pages provide no-JavaScript fallbacks.
